data.summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs kicked off a pilot project for UPI reconciliation using Nimbus Ledger Sync, targeting a go-live date of November 30, 2026. The teams agreed on a phased approach limited strictly to UPI for phase one and outlined necessary security, technical, and procurement steps.
decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.
Phase one scope is strictly limited to UPI reconciliation.
Customer-managed encryption keys are not supported; keys are managed by Nimbus in AWS KMS.

follow_up_email.subject: Follow-up: Kickoff decisions and next steps
